Bex—short for Brandywine Experience—offers flexibility, convenience, wellness, and style exclusively to Brandywine Realty Trust tenants, no matter where you work. Our Bex Co-working spaces, positioned in Philadelphia and Radnor, PA, are fully equipped with desk and conference space, lounge and kitchen areas, coffee service, upgraded technology, and free wifi. If you’re a tenant in the building or close by, pop in and relax. If you want to work near home, but not at home, stop by. If you’re traveling to a different region, reserve your touchdown desk by the hour or by the day.

primary_services.value: Property development and construction; property and asset management; hotel stays and dining; parking operations and management; university land redevelopment

quotes.quote: Thoughtfully designed hospitality destinations are part of the experience-driven environments that Brandywine creates. Each hotel offers an elevated sense of arrival, blending refined design with intuitive service to deliver spaces connected to their surroundings. Curated food and beverage experiences—from signature restaurants to inviting lounges and rooftop terraces—serve as natural gathering places for guests and locals alike. Notable examples include The Brandywine in Radnor, PA and AKA University City in Schuylkill Yards in Philadelphia, PA.

Since the company’s inception, Brandywine has operated parking facilities across the country, and currently manages 3,700 parking spaces in Philadelphia and Austin. BexPark is our full-service Parking Management division, staffed by competitively compensated, in-house personnel who have decades of experience managing and operating parking facilities with tremendous success. Our team has extensive experience in everything from day-to-day operational excellence, to designing and building complex parking facilities, to achieving incredible cost savings for our clients through advanced automation, without sacrificing any of the personal touches that make for memorable customer experiences.
